static_traits.name: Chen Jun
static_traits.family_status: Living with 8 brothers; parents in their 80s
static_traits.social_status: Close relationships with brothers and parents, but unwilling to talk to family about own insecurity; has friends to confide in but Not mentioned work-related insecurity yet; appearance inferiority affecting social confidence and building intimate relationships
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without prior psychological problem treatment / counseling history
static_traits.language_features: Clear logic, fluent expression, able to identify and describe emotions and thoughts; highly cooperative, Positive attitude; having self-criticism and absolutist expressions, marked Anxiety and worry

basic_info.main_problem: I have a very thick beard, think my appearance is sloppy, will never find a Female friend; this inferiority has lasted from adolescence to now, triggered when Seeing happy couples or when people comment on appearance, or when looking in the mirror.
basic_info.core_demands: Long troubled by the belief 'because of sloppy appearance will never find a Female friend', already affecting self-esteem and relationships; hoping to ease catastrophizing and Self-denial through counseling, improving self-evaluation and building intimate relationships.
growth_experiences: Starting in adolescence, felt inferior because of appearance (thick beard, a sense of sloppiness) and society's aesthetic and grooming standards; afterwards this belief has continued into adulthood, and is strengthened when seeing couples or evaluations of appearance.
Long living with a large family (8 brothers, aging parents), Family relationships close, but feeling uncomfortable expressing own insecurity, tending to keep vulnerable emotions inside.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others all have happy relationships while I have not, it shows I am not needed, not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids social scenes related to partners, reduces proactive socializing to avoid being compared and judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find a Female friend

special_situations.event: Others' comments about one's appearance or beard
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others comment on my appearance, it proves I am sloppy, no one will like me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively cares about grooming and appearance or avoids related topics, reducing interaction with people to lower chances of being commented on
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am very sloppy, unattractive

special_situations.event: Missing a drone delivery deadline once at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, it means I am incompetent and will be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works overtime to make up, harshly criticizes oneself, tries to gain a sense of safety through excessive effort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be fired; I am too terrible

special_situations.event: Still reviewing work after completing deadline tasks on time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only perfect error-free is safe; any small mistake brings serious consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking and worrying, hard to stop thinking about possible errors, Sleep affected

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and loved (to gain affirmation and security in intimate relationships and work)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being shamed and losing worth (being negated or fired at Work, abandoned in relationships)
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes through self-reproach and excessive effort, seeking control and safety
Keeping vulnerability in check, reducing exposure of unease to relatives and friends to avoid being evaluated

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed, not-attractive-enough self that may fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges / people who may reject or negate oneself at any time (potential partners, bosses, society)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about missing deadlines or worrying about being evaluated by superiors
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will negate oneself like harsh judges, mistakes meaning punishment or being fired
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeatedly emphasizing 'I should not have made mistakes, I am too terrible' in a Self-blame and guilt tone, avoiding deep emotional experience, turning to detail overtime remedy plans and improvement checklists.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to directly discuss appearance inferiority and intimate-relationship Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing vulnerability will be looked down on or Being rejected, thus needing to stay rational and in control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained tone, rather rational, using analytical and planning expressions (like 'I need to list steps, optimize processes'), reducing subjective emotion words and body-feeling descriptions.

manifestations: Believing 'will never find a Female friend' due to sloppy appearance, strongly triggered by Seeing couples, unwilling to discuss insecurity with family
outcomes: Social avoidance and difficulty building intimate relationships

manifestations: Taking social aesthetic and grooming standards undigested as self-standards, setting rigid Demands for appearance and Work performance
outcomes: Inner tension and Increased stress, hard to accept oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizing society's standards for appearance and grooming into 'must' rules
Evaluating oneself with absolutist statements like 'will never find a Female friend'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Harshly blames self after missing a deadline and works excessive overtime to regain control
Speaks cautiously in sessions, fearing being misunderstood or judged
Repeatedly doubting whether mistakes were made despite finishing on time

exception_events.target_problem: When facing important Work deadlines, Chen Jun typically Self-doubts and catastrophically predicts being fired, thus overworking and experiencing insomnia and persistent worry.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a deadline task last week, Chen Jun delivered on time; although still worried, did not yet overwork uncontrollably or experience severe insomnia as before.
exception_events.reason: Cues: the main reason for missing deadlines before was over-scheduling and task overload; this time not yet taking on too many tasks at once, rhythm more controllable, and able to recall own past on-time deliveries and colleagues' positive feedback as support.

positive_force: Close to family; has a potential support network
Good self-Reflection ability, willing to seek help and participate in cognitive restructuring
Has had multiple on-time deliveries at work and positive feedback from colleagues, with evidence of competence
Detail-oriented with a strong sense of responsibility
negative_force: Introjecting social aesthetic standards as rigid rules, Self-deprecation about appearance
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and overgeneralization are prominent
Gaining short-term sense of control through overworking and self-blame after missing deadlines, Reinforcing the vicious cycle
Avoidance and shame on intimate relationship topics, lowering the possibility of attempts and connection
Sleep impaired and Persistent anxiety weakening resilience

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic Self-deprecation and overworking when facing Work deadlines (accompanied by persistent worry and insomnia)
antecedent: Receiving feedback from superiors or colleagues
The thought 'I will be fired / I am a failure' appearing in the mind
target_behavior.core_reason: Views a single mistake as total failure (overgeneralization and black-and-white), exchanges excessive effort for a sense of safety and control, avoiding criticism or losing the job
target_behavior.function: Avoids the threat of negative evaluation and gains short-term control / safety
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified, Sleep impaired, exhausted energy and Decreased efficiency, further weakening Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids intimate contact and reduces social initiative due to appearance inferiority
antecedent: Looks in the mirror and focuses on one's 'sloppy' spots
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjecting social aesthetics as rigid standards, core belief being 'I am not attractive / not worthy of being loved'
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential rejection and shame experiences, maintaining superficial emotional stability
target_behavior.consequence: Hard to start and maintain intimate relationships, worsened Impaired self-esteem and Loneliness
